text: Corinne bent it into the dark. I'm going to project it. A slow lander at midnight, under the deck lights — the fish is a flash of light under the water, and the man is a flash of patience above it. Other fish in the sea — that's not a shrug. That's a whole city of light he hasn't met yet.
You make losing sound like winning.
In the memory, it is. The fish that got away is the one that glows.
